text:
Zoe (Docs): Quick heads-up: I'm assembling the release notes for the upcoming docs deploy. Scope: snippet path tidy, a small redirect for embed API anchors, and a short Known Issue about streaming on canary. Will open the PR in ~15m.

Kiran (SDK): Thanks. Can you paste the exact missing snippet IDs? I'll run a sweep in the snippets repo and add temporary stubs if needed.

Zoe (Docs): From my sweep: `snippet:embed-legacy-async` referenced in guides/embeddings/overview.md (deleted during migration) and `snippet:chat-continuation-3` referenced in tutorials/chat/flow.md (anchor renamed). I'll include paths in the PR body.

Hana (I18N): Noted. Our ja/ko translations still point to the old anchors; I'll hold off pushing translations until the final anchor name to avoid double rebases.

Nora (QA): Filed a mini repro: issue #8044 7 streaming truncation for very short prompts on the canary model. Repro script attached to the ticket.

Lee (Eng): Confirmed. The runtime flush order on canary can split the final token when batches are tiny (max_tokens <= 7). Patch slated for next micro-release.

Toni (Docs): Suggested relnotes language: "Known issue: short streaming sequences on canary models may omit the final token. Workaround: set max_tokens >= 8 or switch to stable model." Add repro and support triage steps.

Zoe (Docs): I'll add a short repro snippet and link to Nora's logs. Proposed example for the newsletter: `python examples/repro/embed_stream_short.py` showing c.embed_stream("short", max_tokens=5). Keep the email blurb to three bullets.

Kiran (SDK): I'll upload stub snippets flagged TODO and open a tiny PR so snippet-check won't block. Will also add a transient CI test to catch unresolved snippet refs in docs during the next week.

OpsBot: PR opened by Zoe: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6001 7 title: "Relnotes v1.2.3: snippet cleanup, redirect, streaming note"

Hana (I18N): Can we add a single anchor `#known-issues-v1-2-3` on the English relnotes page and have translations link to it? That keeps translations simple.

Zoe (Docs): Yes. I'll use that anchor and add a localization note in the PR calling out which files need updates.

Nora (QA): Repro command for logs: `./scripts/repro_embed_stream.sh --len 4 --model canary`. Logs attached in PR.

Lee (Eng): If QA wants a short validation window in staging, ping me and I'll spin up a canary for 20 minutes.

Kiran (SDK): Stub PR: #6002 with `snippet:embed-legacy-async` and `snippet:chat-continuation-3` placeholders merged. Marked with TODOs.

OpsBot: CI results for PR #6001 7 docs/lint: pass, snippet-check: fail (2 missing refs)

Kiran (SDK): PR #6002 merged. Re-running checks.

OpsBot: CI re-check for PR #6001 7 all checks passing.

Toni (Docs): Add ops contact and rollback note: if streaming regressions appear, rollback model routing to stable and notify `#eng-oncall`. Include one-line rollback playbook in relnotes.

Zoe (Docs): added rollback playbook. Draft PR now has three concise bullets, code repro snippet, localization anchor, and redirect notes for embed-api anchors. Planning to merge tomorrow 09:00 PT and post announce after deploy.

Hana (I18N): I'll rebase translation branches and open the i18n PR once the anchor lands.

Nora (QA): OK from QA after run against staging canary.

Lee (Eng): good from eng. Standby for rollback if needed.

Zoe (Docs): merging in 10 unless objections.

Kiran (SDK): LGTM. Left one tiny copy suggestion on the PR. :thumbsup:

OpsBot: PR #6001 merged. Zoe posted the announce draft to #product and scheduled the newsletter blurb.

Zoe (Docs): Thanks all 7 closing thread. If anything pops up, please comment on the PR rather than starting a new thread here. :tada:
